snippet.title: One Coin Museum - Steam Launch Page Trailer - 2026
snippet.description:
Explore, collect, and curate your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, sail across vast oceans to uncover treasures with your claw. Display them to attract visitors, and grow your reputation. Upgrade your boat to travel farther and discover the world’s hidden wonders.

Wishlist on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4567210/One_Coin_Museum
